Title: 488608-2026: France – Architectural and engineering services and surveying services – private project management contract for the restoration and rehabilitation of the central pavilion of the Fondation Deutsch de la Meurthe at the Cité internationale universitaire de Paris
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: The project is a campus/university building with heritage restoration and includes structural and timber structures as well as fire protection, and is therefore technically of interest for sbp. Since it is a refurbishment in France (not the DACH region) and there is no bridge or large-span structure involved, the priority is only moderate.
titel: Private award of planning services for the restoration and refurbishment of the central pavilion of the Fondation Deutsch de la Meurthe at the Cité internationale universitaire de Paris
kurzbeschreibung: Restoration and refurbishment of a historic university building in Paris with full planning services.
umfang: Restoration and refurbishment of the central pavilion of the Fondation Deutsch de la Meurthe at the Cité internationale universitaire de Paris; existing building with heritage conservation requirements; full planning mission including preliminary DIAG existing-condition analysis, fire protection, structural and timber structure design, technical building services, acoustics, accessibility, environmental and energy performance; duration 48 months.
leistungen: Full Maîtrise d’oeuvre planning services, preliminary DIAG mission, fire protection design, structural design and timber construction, specialist design CVC/Thermal/STD/district heating network, electrical design for heavy and low current, acoustics, life-cycle and operating cost expertise, accessibility, environmental expertise, SSI, cost planning.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Strategically relevant building construction project with listed or historic fabric and an interdisciplinary planning approach.
• Structural and timber engineering expertise are explicitly required, which fits well with sbp.
• Early involvement via a planning team is possible, even though the tender is architect-led.
• The Paris location is geographically attractive for sbp.
• Sustainability, energy performance and low-nuisance construction site are positive aspects.
• A limiting factor is that it is not a large-span special structure or a bridge and the focus is strongly on overall planning.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs are stated in the notice. A reliable estimate is not possible due to the lack of information on areas, scope of heritage protection, depth of intervention and technical parameters. Given the historic refurbishment in Paris with comprehensive specialist planning, a rough assumption would be a medium to higher double-digit million volume, but this is not reliable enough for a numerical indication.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee is stated in the notice. As only an overall planning service in a negotiated procedure is described and neither construction costs nor a fee basis are available, no reliable numerical indication is possible.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Required are: architect for heritage conservation; technical design offices for structures and timber structures, CVC/Thermal/STD/district heating network, electrical heavy and low current, acoustics; expertise in life-cycle and operating costs; accessibility PSH; environmental expertise with low-impact construction site, waste management and energy performance; SSI; construction economist. At least 4 applicants will be selected for the second phase.
zuschlagskriterien: The conditions for participation, selection of applications and award are set out in the tender documents; specific criteria and weightings are not stated in the notice.
auftraggeber: Cité internationale universitaire de Paris, 17 boulevard Jourdan, 75014 Paris, France; Contact: Aurore Legay-Juy; E-mail: achats@ciup.fr; Telephone: 0144166463; Website: https://www.achatpublic.com/sdm/ent2/gen/index.jsp
notes: Two-stage negotiated procedure with prior call for competition; exactly 4 bidders will be invited to the second phase. Contract notice amendment postpones the deadline to 17.07.2026, 12:00. Tender documents available only in French.
